attribution.note: Marcus reposts his own remarks to CNN on his Substack and endorses them; the Ed Elson tweet is not used.

semantics.note: 'Going to investigate' and 'going to be top-line... throughout at least the next year' are firm. 'Maybe going longer' is hedged and correctly adds no commitment.

contract.note: Reading 'top-line' as a prominent, sustained priority is a fair plain reading. Using the later endpoint (end of 2027) for the horizon does not disadvantage the speaker. The vague 'top-line' and the scope of the matter remain flagged.

evidence.note: Wyden/Neal letter of 12 Nov 2026 opening an investigation. It predates the forecast and says nothing about how long the inquiry lasts. It is a congressional record, though tagged as a company disclosure.
Raskin statement on the evaluation date showing Democratic attention and an inquiry opened the week before. It cannot show that the investigation is sustained through 2027.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast that an investigation will be sustained for about a year. The horizon runs to 31 Dec 2027 and the evaluation date is 23 Nov 2026, so it is not due. The evidence shows inquiries have started but cannot show persistence. No decisive event prevents completion, so there is no early contradiction.

attribution.note: Marcus's own remarks to CNN, reposted and endorsed on his Substack.

semantics.note: 'There's going to be an enormous number of shareholder lawsuits' is a firm forecast with no deadline. Tying 'around this' to the reinstatement is a fair reading of the context.

contract.note: 'Enormous' has no threshold, so the result depends on the plain reading 'exceptionally large volume', which is ordinary and fair. Requiring a comparison with similar disputes is demanding but reasonable. The contract is mislabelled 'retrospective' when the claim is prospective.

evidence.note: CNN report confirming the reinstatement on 23 Nov 2026. It establishes the antecedent only and gives no count of lawsuits, so it is context, not support for the outcome.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast with no deadline. The reinstatement happened, but the packet has no verified count of reinstatement-related shareholder suits and no comparison with similar disputes. A small or absent early count cannot contradict an open-horizon forecast, so the claim is unresolved.
